title: Spiced Roasted Cauliflower
description: Cauliflower florets roasted until golden and nutty with cumin, turmeric and garlic, finished with lemon and herbs.

image.alt: Spiced golden roasted cauliflower on a sheet pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin, turmeric, garlic powder and salt on the baking sheet.
Spread it in a single layer and roast, stirring once, until tender and deeply golden at the edges, {time 25-30 min}.
Toss with the lemon juice and herbs and serve. A drizzle of tahini sauce is good on top.

notes: Turmeric stains; use a wooden spoon you don’t mind turning yellow.
